fit: Targeted interface shaping, layout, type, color, review and refinement; commands and project design context.
avoid: Do not load all commands, initialize context files or enable hooks without permission; not a second primary design owner.
use: Read relevant command and project PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md; use critique/audit as review rather than proof.

sources.locator: Version-appropriate relevant section; re-read before use

evidence: documentation reviewed; no independent visual benchmark
